name: 咖色迷彩工装雪裤
description: 咖啡色系迷彩阔腿雪裤：松紧腰配抽绳，前后和两侧都是带金属按扣的工装大口袋，裤脚可以抽绳收紧。很好搭，配纯色上衣就很酷。尺码 S。
descriptionEn: Wide-leg snow pants in a brown camo print, with an elastic drawstring waist, snap-button cargo pockets front, back and on the sides, and drawcord cuffs. Easy to style — pair them with a solid top for an effortlessly cool look. Size S.

name: 东北大花滑雪套装
description:
满身大红牡丹和凤凰的东北大花图案，连帽宽松上衣配同款雪裤，喜庆又抢镜，男女都能穿。
均码，适合身高 160–175 cm、体重 75 kg 左右。
descriptionEn:
Bold northeastern Chinese floral print with big red peonies and phoenixes: a roomy hooded jacket with matching pants. Festive, eye-catching and unisex.
One size, fits about 160–175 cm (5'3"–5'9") and up to about 75 kg (165 lb).

name: 浅蓝星星毛绒拼接滑雪套装
nameEn: Sky Blue Star Sherpa Snow Suit
description: 天蓝色滑雪套装，胸前和袖子拼着奶白色羊羔毛，背后和袖子上缝着毛绒大星星，帽子一圈毛边。复古又温柔。尺码 S。
descriptionEn: A sky-blue snow suit with cream sherpa panels across the chest and sleeves, big fluffy stars on the back and sleeves, and a fleece-trimmed hood. Retro and soft. Size S.
